author: Frank Asante Van Laarhoven
research_question: Which authored scene-graph elements correspond to physical objects suitable for pre-query ownership declaration?
explicitly_not_a_rule: same parent = same physical owner. BP_DoorEntrance_2651 already disproves it, and this enumeration must not re-derive it.

scope.sampling: NONE — complete traversal of the scene

adoption_standard: only DECLARED is sufficient for automatic owner adoption; nothing in this preregistration establishes another admissible standard
selection_rule: semantic validity, never pass rate. A heuristic is not adopted because it groups more relations, and never because it would make Hospital targetable.
declaration_vs_inference: every proposed owner must be marked as explicitly declared in scene or repository metadata, or as inferred by us. Inference is never silently promoted to declaration.
counterexample_limitation: BP_DoorEntrance_2651 is an Office prim. It is characterised from the archived acd53d0 Office audit rather than by running Office, which this tranche does not authorise.
edit_safety_rule: every edited Python file passes py_compile/ast.parse and focused lint before any scientific execution. A syntax failure is a development failure, never a scientific result.
produces: evidence only — no manifest, no amendment, no scene scoring
